description: This is a Python source file (likely part of a larger ERPNext/ERP system) providing utility functions for stock management such as retrieving stock values, serial numbers, bin management, and handling reposting workflows.

classes.name: InvalidWarehouseCompany
classes.description: Custom exception raised when warehouse does not belong to the specified company.

classes.name: PendingRepostingError
classes.description: Custom exception indicating a pending reposting job that blocks further processing.

methods.name: get_stock_value_from_bin(warehouse=None, item_code=None)
methods.description: Fetches total stock value for a specific warehouse and/or item code.

methods.name: get_stock_value_on(warehouse=None, posting_date=None, item_code=None)
methods.description: Calculates the stock value on a particular date, optionally for a group of warehouses.

methods.name: get_stock_balance(item_code, warehouse, posting_date=None, posting_time=None, with_valuation_rate=False, with_serial_no=False)
methods.description: Returns the current stock quantity for an item in a warehouse, with optional valuation rate.

methods.name: get_serial_nos_data_after_transactions(args)
methods.description: Retrieves serial number data after certain stock ledger transactions.

methods.name: get_serial_nos_data(serial_nos)
methods.description: Gets serial number information from serial numbers.

methods.name: get_latest_stock_qty(item_code, warehouse=None)
methods.description: Retrieves latest stock quantity for an item, optionally in a specific warehouse.

methods.name: get_latest_stock_balance()
methods.description: Fetches current stock values grouped by warehouse and item.

methods.name: get_bin(item_code, warehouse)
methods.description: Fetches or creates a stock bin object for an item in a warehouse.

methods.name: str get_or_make_bin(item_code: str , warehouse: str)
methods.description: Ensures a stock bin exists for an item in a warehouse, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: update_bin(args, allow_negative_stock=False, via_landed_cost_voucher=False)
methods.description: Updates stock counts in a bin; Deprecated, inline replacement recommended.

methods.name: get_incoming_rate(args, raise_error_if_no_rate=True)
methods.description: Calculates the incoming stock rate for an item, referencing valuation and serial numbers.

methods.name: get_avg_purchase_rate(serial_nos)
methods.description: Calculates average purchase rate across serial numbers.

methods.name: get_valuation_method(item_code)
methods.description: Determines the valuation method (FIFO, Moving Average, etc.) for an item.

methods.name: get_fifo_rate(previous_stock_queue, qty)
methods.description: Calculates FIFO rate based on stock batches for outgoing/incoming stock.

methods.name: get_valid_serial_nos(sr_nos, qty=0, item_code='')
methods.description: Validates and returns a list of serial numbers, ensuring consistency with quantities.

methods.name: validate_warehouse_company(warehouse, company)
methods.description: Checks if a warehouse belongs to the specified company.

methods.name: is_group_warehouse(warehouse)
methods.description: Raises an error if the warehouse is a group node, which is not allowed here.

methods.name: validate_disabled_warehouse(warehouse)
methods.description: Ensures warehouse is active and not disabled.

methods.name: update_included_uom_in_report(columns, result, include_uom, conversion_factors)
methods.description: Adds UOM conversion columns to report data based on user-selected UOM.

methods.name: get_available_serial_nos(args)
methods.description: Fetches serial numbers available for an item in a warehouse that are valid at a specific date/time.

methods.name: add_additional_uom_columns(columns, result, include_uom, conversion_factors)
methods.description: Adds UOM conversion columns to detailed result sets.

methods.name: get_incoming_outgoing_rate_for_cancel(item_code, voucher_type, voucher_no, voucher_detail_no)
methods.description: Calculates the rate for stock ledger entries related to cancellations.

methods.name: is_reposting_item_valuation_in_progress()
methods.description: Checks if an item valuation repost process is ongoing.

methods.name: bool check_pending_reposting(posting_date: str, throw_error: bool = True)
methods.description: Verifies if there are pending reposts up to a certain date, optionally raising an error.

ctags.name: check_pending_reposting
ctags.pattern: /^def check_pending_reposting(posting_date: str, throw_error: bool = True) -> bool:$/
